card.name: First piece of drug names
card.fires_on: The opening piece of a drug or brand name that is split into several parts, such as N in Nexletol, Nilotinib or Nelfinavir, and ol in olanzapine. It also fires on un in unblinded.

modes.label: Drug name starts
modes.description: A capital N, X or ol that begins a drug or brand name split into pieces.
modes.example: Indinavir Itraconazole Ketoconazole Lopinavir/ Ritonavir Nefazodone<< N>>elfinavir Ritonavir

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: The start of a split non-drug word such as unblinded or cardio-renal.
modes.example: The study was<< un>>blinded early based on an Independent Data

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing a name with its next piece, such as 'ium' or 'imming'.
card.plain: It lights up on the first piece of a drug name that the model reads in parts, like the N in Nelfinavir.
